content: Given a dataset of words and equations the goal of the EqEmb models is to derive a semantic representation of each equation. EqEmb model equations in the context of words. EqEmb is based on the idea that a good semantic representation of equations could be discovered by expanding the original word context to include any equations that appear in a possibly larger window around it.
